sentences.en: We set out to sea and the wind was good.
The ship was called the Hispaniola.

sentences.ar: سيلفر كان محبوب من كل البحارة.
sentences.en: Silver was loved by all the sailors.

sentences.ar: كان عنده ببغاء بيقول: قطع ذهب!
sentences.en: He had a parrot that said: pieces of eight!

sentences.ar: كان يقول إن الببغاء عمرها ميتين سنة.
sentences.en: He used to say the parrot was two hundred years old.
And that it had seen things that cannot be told.
